message: 告白のあと

name: Azel
message: 「Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
So warm.
It makes me want to hold on tight.

name: Synn
message: 「You're so soft, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you want to stay like this forever?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... I want to stay like this forever」
I want to be with Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「Well, it is winter」

name: Synn
message: 「Not just for the winter! I want to...」

name: Azel
message: 「It'll be hot in the summer, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if it's hot, as long as I'm with you...」

name: Sally
message: 「Mornin'!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sally-chan!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, why are you hugging your futon and babbling like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「My futon!?」
Whoa. She's right! I mistook my futon for Azel!

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, that was hilarious. Look at this troubled hormonal teen.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't just watch--wake me up!」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, shoot. The message, the message.」

name: Synn
message: 「Message?」

name: Sally
message: 「Azel said he had a photoshoot, so he went on ahead.」
I'm actually pretty disappointed.
He wasn't at the library yesterday either, and I didn't get to see him after that.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see... A photoshoot, huh」
He's really into photography, so it can't be helped... right.

name: Sally
message: 「Never mind that, soba, soba!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah! It's soba this morning!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Feels like it's been a while since the two of us walked to school together like this, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Weird, isn't it? Even though it's only been about ten days」

name: Synn
message: 「...It really is」
It's only been about ten days since Azel and I started walking to school together.
It hasn't even been two and a half months since we first met.
Even so, it feels lonely not having Azel beside me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, speaking of 'Kirara'」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Doesn't look like you really care to hear about it」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Well, whatever」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that supposed to mean」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, really, 'Kirara' doesn't matter at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though you watch it so religiously」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, listen. There's something I kinda want you to hear」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, I... Well, the thing is... For a really long time now」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure seem to be having a hard time saying it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course I am!」

name: Synn
message: 「I got it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Whaaat!? Y-You already knew!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, though, because I can't」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I see... You're right... I knew it」

name: Synn
message: 「No matter how close we are, Nanaka, I don't have any money to lend, so I can't lend you any」

name: Synn
message: 「You weren't asking to borrow money?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I ever would! Not when I know the inside of your wallet better than anyone!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, so that's not it... Then what is it?」
Nanaka's footsteps came to an abrupt halt.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」
I sensed her take a deep breath and let it out.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn... I like you」
HEY, SYNN... I LIKE YOU.
Even I could tell she didn't just mean it as a friend.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-That's all I wanted to say! You don't have to answer right away!」
In the cold December wind, I stood frozen for a while.

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun! What are you spacing out for?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, s-sorry」
Azel isn't here since he's running around with his Leica and digital camera.
In fact, he didn't even show up to the classroom.
Which means I haven't even caught a glimpse of him today.
As for Nanaka--
She refuses to meet my eyes.

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly... Even though the Holy Night Festival is right around the corner」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan. You shouldn't get so worked up. Preparations are going smoothly, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai-san. The vice president is just at that age where she'll complain even if a chopstick drops」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, that personality of hers is for life」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say!」
Nanaka said I didn't have to answer right away, though.
Besides, it's not like she actually asked me to go out with her, either.

name: Lolotte
message: 「As they say, the soul of sextuplets lasts till a hundred. That means each person gets sixteen souls, with four left over.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I don't really get what you're trying to say.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, I don't understand it myself. What could it possibly mean?」

name: Ria
message: 「In this case, it's triplets.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That increases it to thirty-three per person! And only one left over.」
Even so, putting off my reply or avoiding giving an answer on whether we'll date isn't right.
Because Nanaka was so serious about it.

name: Synn
message: 「Haaah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaah...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah. Sorry.」

name: Misa
message: 「Are you feeling sick or something?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa! Hissy's actually worried about Master Synn!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Did you eat something bad yourself, Miss Vice President?」

name: Misa
message: 「You two are seriously so rude!」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, what's really wrong? Is something bothering you?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-no... It's nothing I should bring up here.」

name: Ria
message: 「...I see. Well, if you're ever really in trouble, rely on all of us, okay? You, Nanaka-chan, and Azel-chan aren't alone, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Where's Azel?」

name: Melilot
message: 「She has already gone home.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Why?」

name: Melilot
message: 「She mentioned having some errands to attend to.」
In the end, I still haven't been able to see Azel at all since after school yesterday.
I thought I'd be able to see her if I came here, though.

name: Melilot
message: 「Did the two of you have a fight or something?」
A steaming teacup was placed in front of me.

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you think seriously about something for three hours and believe your conclusion is right, that conclusion likely wouldn't change even if you spent three years thinking about it」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well, who knows? It's just something someone from long ago said」

name: Melilot
message: 「You've been thinking seriously about it, haven't you?」
I see.

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe I didn't even need to think about it」
The very fact that I'm hesitating like this is the answer.
And the fact that I came here without any hesitation, too.

name: Melilot
message: 「It seems I was able to be of some help」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. Thank you very much」

name: Melilot
message: 「Answering the questions of those who visit the library is also a librarian's duty」
I finish my tea and stand up.
Closing time is approaching.

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, Melilot-san, around what time do you head home after closing?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't go home」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Because I live here」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure you've heard a bit from Azel, but--」

name: Melilot
message: 「I don't go out at night, so I never have the chance to run into these Demons. Maybe I'll take a stroll tonight」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't even joke about that. I really can't recommend running into the Demons that appear at this academy」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's quite alright. In the unlikely event I meet one, I'll fight it with that book」
Melilot-san pointed at a thick tome bound in tanned leather.
It's certainly thick enough to kill someone if you hit them with it, though.

name: Synn
message: 「They breathe fire and stuff, so something flammable isn't really going to cut it」

name: Melilot
message: 「That's unfortunate」
